title: Project rotation claims every waiting project is read within bounded passes, but a fleet that stays full keeps the cursor and the same batch, so a project beyond the batch is never read
resolution: Bounded the read to passes whose offers move the cursor; scenario Fleet full for many passes and its test (c7d4f298) added; contract section 13 aligned. The gap predates the change: the base kept the cursor after the first fleet decline too.

title: The claim that no later task fits unless capacity frees ignores a new candidate, renewed eligibility, cleared admission pressure, or lifted quarantine between transactions
resolution: Conditioned the claim on unchanged candidates, eligibility, quarantine, and capacity in contract section 5, design, and verification; newly available capacity is deferred to the next pass.

title: Placed by the next pass and up to 5 s later are not guaranteed: another replica or an earlier task may take the slot, and the next pass starts 5 s after a pass ends
resolution: Reworded in design, proposal, and verification to offered in the next pass, in rotation order; timing bounded to one replica without intervening changes, with no hard 5 s bound, as runPeriodically waits after each pass.

title: The test a decline after the fleet ran out of capacity does not move the cursor no longer reaches its scenario, since the pass stops at task-b1
resolution: Removed; the RotationCursor test (resource-admission.test.ts:259) covers the guard. Replaced by a reachable test, a fleet that stays full keeps the cursor until capacity returns.
